execute tools, start subprocesses, or claim that logical agents are workers.
Paid work must carry an explicit integer micro-USD reservation at admission. Contains 69 indexed functions and 5 classes.

nodes.name: delegation_plan.py
nodes.summary:

providers, or prove that supplied prices, durations, or adapter configuration
are accurate outside the explicit mapping supplied by the caller. Contains 12 indexed functions and 1 classes.

nodes.name: evaluation.py
nodes.summary:
Versioned, paired evaluation and promotion gates for supplied optimizer runs.

This module never executes candidate code. Callers supply scalar configuration
records and evaluator-produced attempt records; unknown spend is preserved and
blocks a favorable promotion decision. Contains 18 indexed functions and 4 classes.

nodes.name: evolution.py
nodes.summary:
Bounded local evolution of named algorithm configurations on synthetic fixtures.

This module runs a fixed weighted-max-coverage greedy implementation with a
small supported exponent grid. It is configuration search, not code generation.
No arbitrary code, provider, network, repository, or promotion side effect is
executed. Fixture objective scores are synthetic and monetary cost stays unknown. Contains 21 indexed functions and 3 classes.

nodes.name: execution_graph.py
nodes.summary:
Bounded, read-only projection of control-plane history into an explanation graph.

The projection exposes identifiers, states, safe accounting summaries and relationship
edges. It deliberately never copies task payloads, result bodies, errors, receipts,
checkpoints or lease credentials into the graph. Contains 14 indexed functions and 0 classes.

nodes.name: identity.py

nodes.name: inference_telemetry.py

URL from a request payload, follows redirects, or treats missing measurements
as zero. Public serializers omit endpoint URLs and metric labels. Contains 19 indexed functions and 10 classes.

were persisted before and after each invocation. It does not contact OpenRouter;
the caller supplies trusted local operator assertions for reconciliation. Contains 5 indexed functions and 0 classes.

nodes.name: repository_conflicts.py
nodes.summary:

common base. It never changes refs, checks out files, invokes a provider, runs
hooks, or applies/merges a task. Declared reads are verified against the base
tree but are not runtime read traces. Contains 26 indexed functions and 2 classes.

This registry suppresses duplicate dispatch; it is not a durable job runner and
cannot safely resume an interrupted in-memory integration after a restart. Contains 6 indexed functions and 2 classes.
